why: CurriculumId has no fromStorageKey() factory, so every consumer that only has the raw DB/ContentItem storageKey string re-implements the same 4-line linear scan. Two independent copies live inside core/labels itself — the module that is supposed to own curriculum-identity resolution — and a repo-wide grep for the same loop shape turns up 12 more files (content_index.dart, content_tree.dart, dashboard_screen.dart, curriculum_progress_screen.dart, achievement_unlock_celebration.dart, achievements_overview_provider.dart, learning_track_card.dart, curriculum_progress_service.dart, chart_data_service.dart, text_display_screen.dart, after_track_change_invalidation.dart) outside this batch, for context only. If storageKey matching semantics ever change (legacy key aliasing during a future curriculum migration, case-insensitivity, etc.) every copy must be found and fixed by hand; miss one and it silently keeps stale behavior.
recommendation: Add a static CurriculumId.fromStorageKey(String key) (or extension getter) beside CurriculumId.storageKey in core/enums/curriculum_id.dart; replace both in-batch call sites with it as the reference fix, then sweep the other 12 call sites.
acceptance_criteria: curriculum_label_providers.dart and curriculum_label_renderer.dart both call a single shared CurriculumId.fromStorageKey().
grep -rn "for (final id in CurriculumId.values)\|for (final c in CurriculumId.values)" lib/ returns zero hits outside the new factory's own implementation.
